commands.review_summary:
The branch changes the Mattermost inbound verbose preview to use `truncateUtf16Safe` and adds a websocket-path regression test for an emoji at the preview boundary.

PR surface: Source +1, Tests +48. Total +49 across 2 files.

Reproducibility: yes. from source inspection: current main and `v2026.6.11` raw-slice `bodyText` at 200 UTF-16 code units, so a 199-ASCII prefix followed by an emoji reaches the lone-surrogate cut point. I did not run tests because this review is read-only.

target.title: fix(mattermost): truncate inbound preview on code-point boundary
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes garbled verbose inbound previews in Mattermost when message bodies contain emoji or other astral characters near the 200-character preview limit. Raw `slice(0, 200)` could split UTF-16 surrogate pairs, producing lone surrogates in gateway debug logs.

## Why This Change Was Made

Replaces `bodyText.slice(0, 200)` with `truncateUtf16Safe(bodyText, 200)` from `openclaw/plugin-sdk/text-utility-runtime` in the verbose inbound preview path.

## User Impact

Operators enabling verbose Mattermost inbound logging see clean previews on emoji boundaries. No change to message delivery or agent-visible content.

## Evidence

```bash
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run \
  extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor.inbound-system-event.test.ts \
  --reporter=verbose
```

## Real behavior proof

- **Behavior or issue addressed:** Verbose inbound preview could split emoji astral characters at the 200-code-unit boundary.
- **Real environment tested:** macOS (Darwin arm64), Node.js v22.22.0, local source checkout on branch `fix/mattermost-monitor-utf16-truncation`.
- **Exact steps or command run after this patch:**
  1. `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs run extensions/mattermost/src/mattermost/monitor.inbound-system-event.test.ts --reporter=verbose`
- **Evidence after fix:**

```text
 ✓ keeps verbose inbound previews on complete UTF-16 boundaries

 Test Files  1 passed (1)
      Tests  11 passed (11)
```

- **Observed result after fix:** A 199-ASCII + emoji + tail message produces preview `"aaa…aaa"` (199 `a` chars) with no split surrogate; verbose debug line matches production monitor path.
- **What was not tested:** Live Mattermost websocket connection against a remote server.
